title: Dialogues
subtitle: A2 · Unit 2: What happened this week?

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Notice how each speaker gives a time, an action and one useful detail. The listener asks a short follow-up question.

steps.title: The parcel came late
steps.body: Awa asks a neighbour whether a delivery notice arrived.

examples.fr: Tu as trouvé un avis de passage hier ?
examples.en: Awa: Did you find a delivery notice yesterday?

examples.fr: Oui. J'ai trouvé l'avis près de la porte hier soir.
examples.en: Sam: Yes. I found the notice by the door yesterday evening.

examples.fr: Merci. Le colis est pour moi; je téléphone au service aujourd'hui.
examples.en: Awa: Thanks. The parcel is for me; I am calling the service today.

examples.fr: Malheureusement, la livraison a commencé en retard.
examples.en: Sam: Unfortunately, the delivery started late.

examples.fr: J'ai appelé le service, puis j'ai réclamé un remboursement.
examples.en: Awa: I called the service, then requested a refund.

examples.fr: Et quel événement a changé ton horaire ?
examples.en: Sam: And what event changed your schedule?

examples.fr: Heureusement, ils ont confirmé la livraison pour demain.
examples.en: Awa: Fortunately, they confirmed the delivery for tomorrow.

examples.fr: Tu as étudié après le cours ?
examples.en: Nadia: Did you study after class?

examples.fr: J'ai emprunté un livre et j'ai préparé mon exposé.
examples.en: Sam: I borrowed a book and prepared my presentation.

examples.fr: Tu as terminé le devoir aussi ?
examples.en: Nadia: Did you finish the assignment too?

examples.fr: Oui, j'ai terminé le devoir à six heures.
examples.en: Sam: Yes, I finished the assignment at six.

examples.fr: Moi, j'ai marché vingt minutes après le cours.
examples.en: Nadia: I walked for twenty minutes after class.

examples.fr: Tu as commencé le cours à l'heure prévue ?
examples.en: Sam: Did you start class at the scheduled time?

examples.fr: Oui, finalement. J'ai marché jusqu'à la station.
examples.en: Nadia: Yes, in the end. I walked to the station.

steps.prompt: Where did Sam find the delivery notice?
steps.explain: Sam says he found it near the door.

steps.prompt: What did Awa ask the service for?
steps.explain: Awa says she asked for a refund.

steps.prompt: What did Sam do after borrowing a book?
steps.explain: Sam says he borrowed a book and prepared his presentation.

steps.prompt: How did Nadia get to the station?
steps.explain: Nadia says she walked to the station.
